news.summary: China is aiming to account for at least 25% of first-in-class drugs as part of a five-year push to cement its emerging status as a hotbed for innovative R&D.

news.title: Beyond clinical endpoints: Rethinking ALS drug development through disease biology
news.summary: After decades of hard-won progress, ALS drug development is entering a new era, building on established efficacy measures like survival and ALSFRS-R with biology-driven science that captures the full heterogeneity of the disease.

news.title: With pioneering ADHD data, Alkermes eyes orexin agonist as potential ‘company changer’
news.summary: Following Takeda’s historic approval of the first orexin agonist with its narcolepsy treatment Orzeyful, Alkermes has followed up with pioneering data that looks to take the hyped drug class out of sleep disorders and into broader patient populations.

news.summary: Beacon Therapeutics has found the light in a rare vision loss disease that has left larger companies in the dark. The biotech’s gene therapy for X-linked retinitis pigmentosa (XLRP) successfully improved visual acuity in a pivotal trial, setting up the startup to seek regulatory approval.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Search Index
papers.summary: Information retrieval is increasingly important as LLM agents tackle complex tasks involving diverse information needs. Because retrieval relies on an index that represents each document through index keys, retrieval quality depends heavily on how effectively these keys expose the knowledge contained in each document. However, effective index representations vary across retrieval environments, making it difficult for any fixed optimization strategy to perform consistently.
